assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.trigger: Official regulatory conditions / design-brief attachments published
assumptions.impact: Recalculate FAR/height/setback claims; do not treat current unknowns as zeros.

assumptions.statement: Announced overall design area is about 11.4 km2; provisional site polygon recomputes to ~11,412,825 m2 (~0.11% difference). Values are not interchangeable.
assumptions.impact: Rebuild site_boundary and all derived metrics/figures/HTML/manifest digests.

assumptions.statement: Enterprise pack-year/pack-season lease of public under-canopy seats is an operations intention only: seats remain under Shared Desk Protocol (no private pods); revenue and happiness effects are hypotheses, not guaranteed ROI.
assumptions.trigger: Operator assigned + lease rules approved + minimum public seats protected in contract
assumptions.impact: Until then, describe only as concept; do not publish lease fee tables as facts.

assumptions.statement: Higher-capacity guideway modes (including maglev as a long-horizon concept) are corridor cross-section / clearance / title interface reserves only—not approved alignment, mileage, or construction.
assumptions.trigger: Statutory transport study + safety case + assigned operator
assumptions.impact: Keep near-term scope to guiding rails + soft paving; AV/higher modes remain NOT AUTHORIZED until Gates pass.

assumptions.statement: International urban/park/AI-ecosystem cases supply transferable mechanisms only; FAR, budgets, ridership KPIs, and governance powers are not transplanted to Haidian.
assumptions.impact: Case tables stay background_only in sources.json.
